set.approach: Take the Whiskey Mountain and Ross Lake trail to a huge meadow. In the meadow the Whiskey Mountain Pinnacle stands out to the south-southwest; thrash around its northern side and continue west to the neighbouring rocks, the Chocolate Factory. The route is on the south side, in the offwidth inside the tall narrow arch on the west edge of the face.
set.descent_text: The north side of the Chocolate Factory is a walk-off.

review.notes: Area page: approach and walk-off; route page: arch and start. Counts (miles, gain) left out as single-source.

set.approach: The Cirque of the Moon sits on the far side of the North Fork Popo Agie from the trail and is a long walk from the Dickinson Park trailhead; the Big Sandy trailhead by way of the Cirque of the Towers is another way in. The floor of the cirque is boulders and rubble, with one patch of tundra for tents near a tarn. The route is on Sunset Wall: from camp, pass the raspberry bushes, head for the toe of the wall, then go left along the base and back right into the alcove.

review.notes: Area page: access; route page: start from camp. Stored 1 pitch vs the page's 11-pitch wall route (pitch-count mismatch). No descent for the full route.

set.approach: The Cirque of the Moon sits on the far side of the North Fork Popo Agie from the trail and is a long walk from the Dickinson Park trailhead; the Big Sandy trailhead by way of the Cirque of the Towers is another way in. The floor of the cirque is boulders and rubble, with one patch of tundra for tents near a tarn. The route is on the big wall facing east, to your right on entering the cirque: from camp, walk directly to the foot of the buttress where it still stands steep, and do not go around the corner.

review.notes: Area page: access; route page: start. No descent source.

set.approach: The Cirque of the Sun sits just south of the Monolith Cirque and is reached by following the North Fork trail out of Dickinson Park. The way into the cirque is short and steep, and the walls are simple to reach once you are in. The route is just right of Icarus: start at the foot of a low-angle ramp at the mouth of the gully and chimney, below a left-facing shallow dihedral.

review.notes: Area page: approach; route page: start. Route was not completed; no descent from the top.
